description: This file implements a client-side hot module replacement (HMR) and error overlay handler for a development environment in a Next.js project. It manages Webpack hot updates, error overlays, and communication with the server for live reloading during development.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initializes the HMR connection, registers error overlay, and sets up message listener for hot updates.

methods.name: clearOutdatedErrors
methods.description: Clears previous compile errors from console if any.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful compilation, attempts to apply hot updates.

methods.name: handleWarnings
methods.description: Handles compilation warnings, logs them, and attempts hot updates.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Handles compilation errors, displays overlay, logs errors, and prevents hot reload.

methods.name: onFastRefresh
methods.description: Handles actions after a successful fast refresh, including overlay updates and latency logging.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages related to build status, errors, and updates.

methods.name: isUpdateAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a newer build hash is available for hot update.

methods.name: canApplyUpdates
methods.description: Checks if Webpack hot module replacement is in an idle state and ready for updates.

methods.name: afterApplyUpdates
methods.description: Executes a callback after updates are applied, waiting for idle status if necessary.

methods.name: tryApplyUpdates
methods.description: Attempts to perform hot module replacement, falls back to full reload on failure.
